verdict: Leads surged and cost per lead hit its best rate yet — intake is the gap.
narrative: This period you received 93 leads at a cost of $19.39 each — the lowest cost per lead recorded in this campaign's history, driven by stronger efficiency in Meta's ad auction. The problem is downstream: of those 93 leads, only 77 are reflected in your CRM, and none have moved into an active case opportunity, meaning the bottleneck is in follow-up and intake, not in the ads. SMS automation and voice access — the two tools built to close that gap — are being activated now and will be the immediate focus. Once those are live, you should see leads begin converting into tracked pipeline entries, which is the number that matters most for your business next period.
